Because the state is exposed only to droughts in its interior districts.
Because its entire coastline is free from cyclone risk but has frequent earthquakes.
Because its major hazards are restricted to landslides in the Eastern Ghats.
x: Andhra Pradesh faces the combined risks of east-coast cyclones, hazards associated with two major deltas and drought in its interior, requiring multi-hazard planning.
tq: Combine the three geographic risk features before selecting the comprehensive explanation.
